mechanism_claims.claim_text: DPT9 and K8, 23-DPT9 permeabilize tested microbial membranes in a concentration-dependent SYTOX Green assay; this supports membrane disruption as a direct antimicrobial mechanism for the tested organisms.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DPT9 and K8, 23-DPT9 against the tested bacterial and Candida strains
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure 7 is graphical; exact fluorescence values are not tabulated in local text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DPT9 and K8, 23-DPT9 inhibit biofilm formation and have weaker eradication activity against established biofilms, supported by MBIC/MBEC values in Table 3.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DPT9 and K8, 23-DPT9 against S. aureus, MRSA, and E. coli biofilms
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm inhibition is an activity phenotype; no quorum-sensing or biofilm pathway mechanism is directly demonstrated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The analogue K8, 23-DPT9 has increased net charge and helicity relative to DPT9, which the authors associate with stronger antimicrobial and antiproliferative activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is SAR association, not a standalone direct mechanism.

unresolved_mechanism_cautions: No exact Figure 7 fluorescence values were extracted from local image material.
